# PromptDock

> PromptDock is an independent open source idea-to-prompt workspace by King Jethro. It helps people turn rough or spoken ideas into structured prompts, keep a synced prompt library, and share selected prompts publicly.

Official site: {{SITE_URL}}/
Source code: https://github.com/kingjethro999/promptdock
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thepromptdock

## What the product does

- Idea to prompt: enter a rough thought or dictate it; PromptDock identifies the goal and useful focus areas, then drafts a prompt.
- Optional fine-tuning: add details such as audience, tone, format, constraints, and priorities to the same idea-to-prompt flow.
- Prompt library: signed-in users can save, search, tag, duplicate, export, and import prompts across devices.
- Public sharing: a user can publish an individual prompt at a public link; private prompts and original idea inputs are not publicly exposed.
- Provider choice: users may use PromptDock's configured AI or add their own supported provider key in Settings.
